protocol.resume: Read the live PR head from GitHub first, then read this checkpoint at that head and query exact-head CI for the live SHA. integration.observed_head is only the last verified pre-checkpoint head, not the current branch head. protocol.selection: Execute all lawful ready obligations by causal priority, first recover goal and restore broken baseline; parallelize independent evidence where useful. Do not narrow whole goal to last changed subsystem. Revisit upstream decisions when contradicted.
protocol.checkpoint: Record the last exact head and CI run actually verified, with matching B00 evidence. A checkpoint commit itself advances the branch, so the file must not claim to contain its own live HEAD or CI result. After any checkpoint update, re-query the new live PR head and exact-head CI from GitHub. Keep the checkpoint a resume record, not CI authority. Update affected obligations, evidence, blocker and next action in the same logical change. Never store raw private goals or secrets in repository. Never claim external actions occurred without readback.
protocol.acceptance: A task may be VERIFIED only with explicit exact-version evidence of its own acceptance and all dependencies VERIFIED; CI proves code checks only. External permissions, independently reviewed actual outputs and native client selection stay unknown until proven.
protocol.stop: All obligations VERIFIED with actual owner outcome; otherwise retain open/blocked tasks and concrete next action. No background work claim.
